zh-CN.title: 主题随特别的日子到来
items: 语言与个性化新增主题：生日当天与圣诞季自动解锁、切换，也可手动选择。
新主题解锁时，菜单、语言与个性化及主题入口会显示红点。

en.title: Themes for your special days
items: Choose a theme in Language & personalization. Birthday and Christmas themes unlock and activate automatically on their dates.
Newly unlocked themes are marked in Menu, Language & personalization, and Theme.
